paper.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: 本文提出通过纯强化学习激励大语言模型推理能力的方法，训练出 DeepSeek-R1-Zero，无需人工标注的推理轨迹即可涌现自我反思、验证等推理模式 [S1.p2][S2.SS3.p5]。为解决 R1-Zero 可读性差和语言混杂等问题，作者进一步提出多阶段训练的 DeepSeek-R1，融合拒绝采样、强化学习与监督微调 [S1.p3][S3.p2]。在数学、编程和 STEM 等可验证任务上，模型取得优于依赖人工示范的监督学习模型的性能 [abstract]。作者还通过蒸馏将推理能力迁移到更小的模型，并公开了模型权重 [S1.p4][A9.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在探索如何以最少的人工标注，通过强化学习框架让大语言模型自我演化出推理能力 [S1.p2]。现有方法依赖人工标注的推理轨迹，限制了可扩展性并引入认知偏差，且模型性能受限于人类提供的示例，无法探索更优的非人类式推理路径 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts
Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases
their performance is inherently capped by the human-provided exemplars, which prevents the exploration of superior, non-human-like reasoning pathways

method.text: 论文基于 DeepSeek-V3-Base，采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 作为强化学习框架，奖励信号仅基于最终预测答案与标准答案的正确性，且跳过了常规的监督微调阶段 [S1.p2]。奖励由规则化的准确性奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。为解决 R1-Zero 的可读性和语言混杂问题，作者提出多阶段框架 DeepSeek-R1，整合冷启动数据、拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调，并引入语言一致性奖励 [S1.p3][S3.p2][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework
The reward signal is solely based on the correctness of final predictions against ground-truth answers
we bypass the conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase before RL training
Our rule-based reward system mainly consists of two types of rewards: accuracy rewards and format rewards
we abstain from applying neural reward models—whether outcome-based or process-based—to reasoning tasks
we collect thousands of cold-start data that exhibits a conversational, human-aligned thinking process
we introduce a language consistency reward during RL training, which is calculated as the proportion of target language words in the CoT

experiments.text: 论文在 MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、IFEval、FRAMES、GPQA Diamond、SimpleQA、C-SimpleQA、SWE-Bench Verified、Aider、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、CNMO 2024 和 AIME 2024 等基准上评估模型 [S4.p1]。评估采用 pass@k 方式，采样温度 0.6、top-p 0.95，每问生成 k 个回答（通常 4 到 64 个）[A4.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p2]。作者还实施了去污染流程，过滤掉与评估问题匹配的 10-gram 序列 [A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our models on MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, and CMMLU, IFEval, FRAMES, GPQA Diamond, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench
we use a sampling temperature of $0.6$ and a top- $p$ value of $0.95$ to generate $k$ responses
we filtered out any text segments (including web pages and GitHub files) that contained matching 10-gram sequences from evaluation questions or reference solutions

findings.text: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的平均 pass@1 从初始的 15.6% 提升到 77.9%，结合自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。训练过程中模型自然增加思考时间，并涌现出反思性推理和系统性探索替代方案等高级推理策略 [S2.SS3.p4][S2.SS3.p5]。最终 DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 相当，在编程算法任务上表现突出，并在 AlpacaEval 2.0 和 ArenaHard 上分别提升 25% 和 17% [S4.p3][A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3]。蒸馏后的小模型也展现出强推理能力，超过其原始指令微调版本 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%
by leveraging the self-consistency decoding, the model’s performance can be further improved, achieving an accuracy of 86.7%
DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
with AlpacaEval 2.0 improving by 25% and ArenaHard by 17%
On math tasks, DeepSeek-R1 demonstrates performance on par with OpenAI-o1-1217, surpassing other models by a large margin
These distilled models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, surpassing the performance of their original instruction-tuned counterparts

limitations.text: 作者承认 DeepSeek-R1 在结构化输出和工具使用方面仍不理想，无法利用搜索引擎或计算器等工具 [S6.p3]。在 token 效率上仍有优化空间，简单问题上存在过度思考现象 [S6.p4]。模型目前针对中英文优化，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混杂 [S6.p5]。此外，模型对提示敏感，少样本提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]。在软件工程任务上，由于评估耗时长影响 RL 效率，未大规模应用强化学习，因此相较 DeepSeek-V3 提升不大 [S6.p7]。纯 RL 方法本身也面临奖励黑客问题，对于无法用可靠奖励模型评估的复杂任务，扩展纯 RL 仍是开放挑战 [S6.p9]。

evidence.quote: the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models
DeepSeek-R1 cannot leverage tools, such as search engines and calculators, to improve the performance of output
there remains room for further optimization in terms of token efficiency, as instances of excessive reasoning—manifested as overthinking—are still observed
DeepSeek-R1 is currently optimized for Chinese and English, which may result in language mixing issues when handling queries in other languages
it is sensitive to prompts. Few-shot prompting consistently degrades its performance
large-scale RL has not been applied extensively in software engineering tasks
for complex tasks that cannot be effectively evaluated by a reliable reward model, scaling up pure RL methods remains an open challenge
